wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Carr form prints NO schedule total on Form A (sheet ends '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper ...)'), so the cover line-1 cells are the only anchor. Four rows sum 1000.00+500.00+500.00+669.00 = 2669.00, equal to cover line 1 CUMULATIVE 2,669.00 and to its LAST-REPORT cell (THIS REPORT cell is a nil glyph '-0-'), so LAST and CUM coincide on this summary report. RHODES-STYLE ARITHMETIC RESOLUTION: the row-4 amount and the line-1 CUMULATIVE cell both end in a bistable 8/9 glyph; the balance line decides (2,669 + 40 - 2,232 = 477 = the printed line-4 balance; 2,668 would give 476), so the digit is 9 in both. Cover line 2 (aggregate <=$50) is 40.00 and is deliberately NOT part of this reconciliation.

expenditures.detail: Form B prints no schedule total. Two rows sum 2159.15+72.85 = 2232.00, equal to cover line 3 in BOTH the LAST-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns (the THIS REPORT cell is blank). The line-3 LAST cell read bistably 2,252/2,232 at 200-1200 dpi; a 2400 dpi crop resolved the middle glyph as the same zig-zag '3' the filer writes in the CUMULATIVE cell, and the Form B sum independently confirms 2,232.00.

gates.page_subtotal: No printed schedule total or page subtotal exists on either Carr schedule (form prints none) - stated, not invented. Gated against the cover instead: p2 rows 2669.00 = cover line 1 CUM 2,669.00; p3 rows 2232.00 = cover line 3 CUM 2,232.00.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p2: 36 bands, pitch 2.21%, status ok; ink occupies bands 1-4 only (filer writes ABOVE each rule) = 4 rows emitted. rowbands.py p3: 31 bands, status 'gaps' (the rule at ~15.93% was not detected); bands mapped by hand against ink = 2 inked rows = 2 rows emitted; all remaining ruled lines are blank.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: first-row box (81.00,11.16,14.00,2.70) renders '1,000.00'; last-row box (81.00,18.27,14.00,2.23) renders '669.00'; control one pitch below (y=20.50) renders EMPTY. p3: first-row box (81.00,11.49) renders '2,159.15'; last-row box (81.00,13.72) renders '72.85'; control (y=15.93) renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: Carr cover has no beginning-balance line. 2,669.00 (line1 cum) + 40.00 (line2 cum) - 2,232.00 (line3 cum) = 477.00 = printed line-4 balance. CLOSES EXACTLY, and this identity is what settled the two bistable glyphs. No other filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk, so no cross-filing chain test was possible.

escalation_note: 1200 dpi cell crops of cover lines 1 and 3 (LAST and CUM columns) and of both schedules' amount columns; 2400 dpi re-crops of cover line-1 CUM, line-3 LAST/CUM and Form A row 4; 1200 dpi crop of the Form B date column.
notes: index.csv says candidate 'Karl Ward', office 'County Council'; the form's 'Full Name of Candidate' reads KARL B. WARD and 'Name of Office' reads CACHE COUNTY COUNCIL - agrees (index drops the middle initial). Office District line left blank by the filer. Political Party REPUBLICAN. Signed/dated 12-8-16; clerk stamp 'CLERK REC'D DEC 12 11:02'. Cover line 2 THIS-REPORT cell is SCRIBBLED OUT by the filer (not a zero and not blank) - recorded as '' with this note; line 1 THIS-REPORT cell carries a nil glyph read as '-0-' = 0 per the zero-glyph ruling. Mailing-address column on Form A is entirely blank for all four rows, so no donor_city/donor_state exist to emit. Candidate's own street address, ZIP and both phone numbers appear in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time. A printing vendor (Watkins Printing) appears as BOTH a Form A contributor (669.00) and the Form B payee; transcribed verbatim, no in-kind inference made (the Carr form has no in-kind column).

contributions.note: written '1,000.00'; date written '6-7-16'; address cell left blank by filer

final digit bistable 8/9 at every resolution; settled as 9 by the cover's own arithmetic (rows must sum to 2,669.00 and 2,669+40-2,232 must equal the printed balance 477.00). Date written '6-10-16'; address cell blank

expenditures.note: date written '6-3-16'; middle digit is the filer's zig-zag 3 (same glyph as the 3 in 2,232.00), read as 5 at 90 dpi - kept at medium. Amount cents digit bistable 8/5; 2232.00-2159.15 = 72.85 fixes it as 8. 'SIGN' is squeezed at the cell edge under 'CAMPAIGN'
